newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia says reluctant lenders hurting S.Korea economy.
newsitem.headline: Kia says reluctant lenders hurting S.Korea economy.

text.p: A growing reluctance by South Korean lenders to extend credit to companies rumoured to be in trouble was damaging the nation's industrial competitiveness, a senior official of the Kia Group said on Tuesday.

"No company in the country would survive if lenders stopped providing credit in the way they are doing to us now," said Oh Min-boo, senior managing director of the group's planning and coordinating office.

He said Kia's financial condition was sound and that the prospects for sales growth were "quite bright". For example, he said group flagship Kia Motors' car exports had expanded 40 percent this year from a year ago.
"I don't understand why some financial instituions have shied away from giving us credits," Oh said.
He also said rumours about Kia's financial trouble had hurt its overseas operations.
